hammurabi-babylon-rise.description: A bearded man in a round-brimmed cap and a fringed, draped wool robe stands on a raised terrace in the foreground, his arm extended and pointing to the right. Behind him, a crowd of helmeted soldiers with long spears and round shields fills the lower half. In the background are mud-brick buildings, a stepped ziggurat-like tower, and a river reflecting a dusk sky of orange and dark grey clouds. The painting fills the frame edge to edge with no visible text, border or signature.

nabopolassar-neo-babylonian-empire.description: A bearded man in a tall cap and embroidered robe, holding a short rod, rides a dark horse through a tall wooden gate in a crenellated mudbrick wall. Armoured spearmen with round shields hold the gate on both sides, and torches and fires burn in the background. In the foreground a toppled winged stone bull with a human head lies in the dust. The palette is dark oil-painting browns and orange, with no visible text, border or frame.

alexander-invades-persia-granicus.description: A clean-shaven young man in a silver muscled cuirass and a helmet with a purple and white plume runs through shallow surf on a muddy shore, holding a long spear diagonally across the frame. Behind him, a crowd of spearmen with round shields and crested helmets advances through smoke under a dark, stormy sky. On the right, a wooden warship with a painted eye on its prow sits in rough waves. The image has no visible text, border or frame, and the paint style is a dark, textured oil painting.

arsaces-founds-parthian-empire.description: A bearded man in a felt cap and layered tunic rides a grey horse at the front of a charge, pointing forward. Behind him, mounted archers in dark hoods draw bows against a background of fire and smoke. To the right, helmeted foot soldiers run toward a walled town with stone towers and a columned classical gateway under a dark, stormy sky. A small faint mark sits in the bottom-right corner. The painting fills the frame edge to edge.

modu-shanyu-xiongnu-empire.description: A mounted man in fur-trimmed armour and a fur hat raises a bow on a dark horse, with mounted warriors, round felt tents, and campfires across a dusky grassland at dusk. No text, frame or blood is visible.
